name: SAMPLE
description: A unique identifier or label for a specific sample being observed or analyzed.

name: LAT
description: The latitude coordinate of the sample location, typically expressed in degrees.

name: LON
description: The longitude coordinate of the sample location, typically expressed in degrees.

name: TOP
description: The depth or elevation of the uppermost boundary of the sample, measured from a reference point.

name: BOTTOM
description: The depth or elevation of the lowermost boundary of the sample, measured from a reference point.

name: N
description: The concentration of nitrogen present in the sample, usually expressed in a specific unit such as mg/kg or %.

name: P
description: The concentration of phosphorus present in the sample, usually expressed in a specific unit such as mg/kg or %.

name: K
description: The concentration of potassium present in the sample, usually expressed in a specific unit such as mg/kg or %.

name: TIME
description: The time at which the sample was collected
